pageDescription: Back up wiki page content to a Git repository. This covers content only and does not include full system restore.
sectionDescription: Automatically pushes wiki changes to the configured remote Git repository. Configure the target repository and credentials in your server settings.
conflictDescription: The remote repository has diverged from the local backup history and cannot be fast-forward merged.
conflictWarning: Clicking Force Push overwrites the remote with the current local backup history. Your wiki content is never lost.
hintDisabled: Git backup is not enabled. To enable it, configure a remote repository in your server environment settings.
manualSectionDescription: Trigger an immediate sync (pull then push) of all current wiki content with the remote repository without waiting for the next scheduled sync.

tooltip.adminConflict: Git backup conflict — manual action required. Click to open backup settings.
tooltip.adminFailure: Last git backup failed. Click to open backup settings.
tooltip.editorConflict: Git backup conflict — contact an administrator.
tooltip.editorFailure: Last git backup failed — contact an administrator.

config.sectionDescription: Configure the Git remote, credentials and sync interval. Changes take effect immediately — no restart needed.
config.envManagedHint: Git backup is configured through environment variables on this server. To change it, update the server configuration; it cannot be edited here.
config.credentialsUnencryptedHint: Authentication is disabled on this server, so there is no key to encrypt credentials at rest. The SSH key and password are stored in plaintext in the configuration file (readable only by the server user).
config.loadError: Failed to load the backup configuration
config.secretKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the stored value
config.sshKeyPathHint: Use this instead of pasting the key if the key file lives on the server.
config.httpPasswordPlaceholder: e.g. a repo-scoped personal access token
config.intervalInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes.
config.intervalOutOfRange: The interval must be between {{min}} and {{max}} minutes.
config.testSuccess: Connection succeeded — the remote is reachable and the credentials are accepted.
config.saveFailed: Failed to save the backup configuration
